name: William Zorn

name: Paige Pride
why: Not the rejected frame. This is a different volume, a different page and a different photograph from the 1991 Talisman p. 119 cell recorded in _do-not-use.json, and it needs no inference from a middle initial. It is the 1993 Talisman senior class portrait grid, p. 42. The 1993 index carries exactly one Pride in the volume, "Pride, Paige 42, 156, 188, 192, 203", and that single entry ties the portrait page to four pages where she is captioned by name: p. 203 reads "Paige Pride, a senior from Tell City, Ind., tries to wash off Brian Lomax" at the Student Alumni Association's Oozeball tournament, and pp. 156, 188 and 192 name Paige Pride in organization group photographs. The grid is four portraits across with each row's four names printed in order in the column to the left; row three reads Connie Priddy, S. Paige Pride, Laura Kay Proctor, Tammy A. Rajewich, and this is the second cell of that row. The grid cell prints her as S. Paige Pride of Tell City, Ind., and the p. 203 caption prints her as Paige Pride, a senior from Tell City, Ind., so the two are the same woman on the volume's own evidence. As a by-product this also settles the 1991 doubt, since the earlier cell reads Susan P. Pride of the same hometown, but nothing here depends on that.
caption_quote: S. Paige Pride, Biochemistry, Tell City, Ind.
